items.title: Caterpillar (CAT) Makes Collision Warning Standard On Most New Construction Machines
items.summary: Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) is making advanced collision warning and mitigation systems standard on most new Cat construction machines. The safety package covers both operator alerts and automatic intervention features designed to reduce contact between machines and people on site. The shift from optional add ons to built in technology raises expectations for jobsite risk management across construction fleets.
